name: Maniac Bounce
description: Delay with bounce pitch and velocity LFO

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — Delay (up = shorter) plus coupled decay (short trails die faster)
Third — Velocity LFO rate + depth (up = faster and deeper)

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Short — Mute / ring-out (block new input; trail plays out)
Long — Panic (clear queue + NoteOffs); skipped if Third was used this hold

sections.heading: Params / LEDs
items: I/O: MIDI→MIDI · MIDI→CV · CV→MIDI; Signal Pitch / Gate / CV→CC / Gate→Note
Free-running ms delay only — no clock sync, no ping-pong
Poly with same-pitch kill; note length ≈ 50% of frozen delay
MIDI→CV: Vel LFO shapes gate pulse width; Pitch CV follows bounce
White flash on input (~20% when muted)

channels.jackDescription: MIDI or CV in, MIDI or CV out per I/O mode. Dry through plus bouncing repeats.
channels.faderDescription: Repeat spacing. Fader up is shorter and decays faster; down is slower with more hops.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Rate and depth together on dry hits and repeats. MIDI→CV Gate uses the same LFO for pulse width.
channels.fnDescription: Short mute (ring-out). Long panic unless you were editing Third.
